CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2579 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 45754ede263322459d69936f5898d26fe64654f4. Bus nonce: 6b482079637569c20a53f5be8570fcfb. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 45754ede263322459d69936f5898d26fe64654f4`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 45754ede263322459d69936f5898d26fe64654f4` or `Fix review: blocked 45754ede263322459d69936f5898d26fe64654f4 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 6b482079637569c20a53f5be8570fcfb`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `45754ede263322459d69936f5898d26fe64654f4` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2579 45754ede263322459d69936f5898d26fe64654f4") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2579-6b482079`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
RE-REVIEW, round 6, ADVERSARIAL, of PR #2579 (group R10-FLOW-YIELD-PROBE, branch fix/r10-flow-yield-probe) at head 45754ede263322459d69936f5898d26fe64654f4. The fixer's code is handoff/r10-flow-yield-probe 218b0af4c (three commits: d2d6dd688 split the guardrail out and pin the group, product and committer-time seams; 29110ab18 kill the regex-character survivors the widened sweep found; 218b0af4c drop the DISPOSED entry PR 21's fixture now kills), merged with main by update_pr.sh. Read the round-5 verdict with `git fetch origin review/2579; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
1. Every round-5 finding is answered by code or by a body line with a Carry. Name any that is not.
2. Re-run the class sweep harness (dev/audit/harnesses/r10_review_strength*) yourself at the head. Report survivors by class. Then try at least five one-line mutants of tools/audit/seat/review_strength.py of your own, outside the classes the sweep generates. A survivor that moves a body figure, or that the self-test passes, is a finding.
3. Re-take every figure in the body at this head. A figure that differs is a finding.
4. The guardrail split (d2d6dd688) must be architecturally sound: one definition, no duplicated logic. Report the archscore dS line (tools/audit/archscore/) at the merge base and at the head. structure.py must pass with no budget raise.
5. The body's `## Red checks` names every red in the branch history (check-runs API).
6. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> is clean, and carry_audit.py check --body against origin/main's roster gives 0 unrouted and 0 bad.
This is round 6. If it blocks again, say in the verdict whether the PR should be split, and what the minimal mergeable part would be (three-round rule).
Time box 60 min.
